changelog: Ultra-Low-Latency Streaming: capture, JPEG encoding and base64 now run on a dedicated worker thread so remote input is never blocked by frame encoding
Zero-Copy DeskRT Codec: vectorized uint32 frame diff, clustered dirty tiles and zero bytes on the wire while the desktop is idle
Dropped-Frame Pipeline: stale frames are discarded instead of queued, so network congestion can no longer build up growing delay
Real Adaptive Bitrate: capture scale, JPEG quality and FPS tune themselves from kernel send backlog, send time and client-reported RTT
Dedicated Viewer Decode Thread: JPEG decoding no longer blocks the websocket reader; FPS and live RTT are shown in the session toolbar
Clean Session Teardown: closing a tab now closes the websocket, stops audio and ends the host stream immediately
Capture Engine Fixes: cached input desktop attachment, 64-bit GDI prototypes, StretchBlt scaled capture and no per-frame handle leak
Connection Fixes: ws:// is used automatically for LAN/private hosts and explicit ws/wss URLs are accepted
Relay Hardening: websocket heartbeat keepalive and stale duplicate registration replacement
